prediction: Sigma_ph = a_0/(pi G) universal, mass-independent (H033 P1)
convention: V_bar^2 = Vgas|Vgas| + 0.5 Vdisk^2 + 0.7 Vbul^2 (RAR-validated by C0)
recipe: Mb = max_r V_bar^2 r/G ; r_M = sqrt(G Mb/a_0) ; Sigma = [M_obs(<r_M) - M_b(<r_M)]/(pi r_M^2) = [g_obs - g_bar]/(pi G) at r_M

results.check:
C0 [CONVENTION] the Upsilon = 0.5/0.7 SPARC convention reproduces the published
      radial-acceleration relation; the Upsilon = 1 loader in G033 does not
results.measured: Upsilon 0.5/0.7 max|dev| = 0.0622 dex ; Upsilon 1.0/1.0 max|dev| = 0.2090 dex (vs McGaugh+2016 fit, a_0 = 1.2e-10)

results.check:
C1 [UNIVERSALITY] d log10 Sigma / d log10 Mb is zero: the surface density
      inside r_M carries no memory of the galaxy's mass
results.measured: canonical +0.2650 +/- 0.0377 dex/dex (7.0 sigma); alternative +0.2524 +/- 0.0310 (8.2 sigma); binned medians rise 1.42 -> 2.13 over 3.86 dex

results.check:
C2 [VALUE vs OBSERVATION] the measured value agrees with the observed universal
      dark-halo surface density, Donato+2009 log10 = 2.15 +/- 0.05
results.measured: median log10 Sigma = 1.910 (canonical) / 1.940 (alternative) -> offset -0.240 / -0.210 dex = -4.8 / -4.2 sigma_Donato

results.check: C3 [VALUE vs THE LEMMA] the measured value equals the predicted a_0/(pi G)
results.measured: measured 81.2 Msun/pc^2 vs predicted 213.7 (canonical) and 257.5 (alternative) -> -0.420 / -0.470 dex

results.check:
C4 [LEVER ARM] the sample spans enough decades in baryon mass to test
      mass-independence at all

results.measured: N = 163 galaxies with r_M inside the observed range and Sigma > 0 (canonical); 157 (alternative); 171 curves usable of 175 files

results.check:
C6 [ROBUSTNESS] the mass trend survives every analysis variant tried
      (M_b estimator, radial bracketing, mass-to-light convention, footing)
results.measured: slopes: primary +0.265, Mb +0.268, strict +0.213, Upsilon1 +0.088, Upsilon1 +0.104
results.threshold: all variants return the same sign of d log10 Sigma / d log10 Mb

results.check:
C7 [BRACKET] the measured value lies between a_0/(2 pi G) and a_0/(pi G),
      the range H033 claimed to bracket the observation
results.threshold: a_0/(2 pi G) <= Sigma_measured <= a_0/(pi G)

headline.verdict: P1 not confirmed: value of the observed order of magnitude, but mass-INDEPENDENT is refuted at 7.0 sigma
